{{Quote|This is the ''Pardlam'', we're just a cargo ship but we have some guns. We'll see you at Shramar.|The crew of the ''Pardlam''|<ref name="Revelation 3" />}}
The '''''Pardlam''''' was a [[Freighter/Legends|cargo ship]]. It was one of the [[Starship/Legends|ships]] that answered the call to aid the ''[[Heart of Artorias]]'' when [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Bylsma (New Republic)|Bylsma]] sent out a request for support to [[Battle of Shramar|defend]] [[Shramar]].<ref name="Revelation 3" /> It shared its name with the [[pardlam]], a large [[Diet/Legends|herbivorous]] creature.<ref name="BT1">[[Blood Ties 1|''Blood Ties'' 1]]</ref>
